ownership.domain: Validated actor, authority, checkpoint and captured-context descriptors; descriptors grant no rights
ownership.execution: Owned authenticated workspace session and opaque captured command context
ownership.storage_sqlite: Concrete protected native namespace and current grant/authority verification
ownership.facade: Explicit local attachment and shared execution entry points
ownership.protocol: Closed v1 inquiry/reply command data codec, canonical command/approval-intent hashes; parsing grants no authority

identity.integer_wire: canonical decimal strings bounded by signed 64-bit maximum
identity.generation: positive; distinct from a public cache generation
identity.participant: validated Nostr x-only key; distinct from the authenticated device/principal

native_scope.namespace: explicit new execution namespace; existing opens never create or infer authority
native_scope.authentication: protected high-entropy credential checked against persisted scoped grant and authority state
native_scope.credential_persistence: verifier only, under protected handling; no plaintext credential in SQL, diagnostics or arguments
native_scope.private_codec: existing context-bound authenticated envelope v2 with explicit qualified provider, key material and unique nonce
native_scope.transactions: Grant creation/revocation and buyer inquiry preparation observe actual SQLite completion. T0 uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE and exact protected grant-row comparison before current proof/generation/route/deadline checks. Provider work finishes before the transaction. Prepared state does not install a message or invoke signing/delivery.
native_scope.initialization: explicit fresh local outbox enrollment; no automatic stock ledger or restore from a key/public cache
native_scope.private_payload_scope: Protected grant plaintext and protocol private-record limits remain distinct from the internal retained command journal.

context.constructor: pure synchronous authenticated workspace-session method; no clock, storage, signer or network effects; arbitrary JSON yields descriptors, never a trusted context
context.approval: descriptor alone is not consent; authoritative admission validates protected origin, exact intent, scope and expiry
context.idempotency: captured semantic input is immutable; correlation is diagnostic only
context.revocation: attachment observation does not replace current transaction-time grant checks

lifecycle: attach work and callbacks remain owned across observer loss; close stops admission and drains work before credentials/callbacks and storage are released

resource_bounds.credentials: zeroizing roots are released at scope/client quiesce; admitted authentication owns its request credential through safe completion

qualification_required: Actual protected native store and correct credential attachment
Wrong credential, participant, workspace, executor, generation, route, grant and checkpoint refusal
Revoked/expired grant refusal and persisted reopen behavior
No context authority from signer observation, public cache or caller-provided descriptors
Full captured context fields, exact strings, explicit null, bounded redacted diagnostics and local/native lifetime checks
Owning native/portable/API/contract checks and unchanged coverage policy
Independent canonical command and approval-intent vectors and closed shape/byte/depth refusals
Actual inquiry commit/reopen/replay, original correlation, digest conflict, proof/revocation/deadline and transaction-time grant checks
Actual SQLite statement failure/confirmed rollback, deferred-constraint commit failure/unknown latch, lost observer and bounded queue/drain
Protected operation-context substitution refusal and predecessor-schema byte preservation
remaining: Complete operation receipts, authenticated reply/history and actual known-kind listing/chat T1/S/T2/D execution
Owned durable workers, per-target delivery and process-fault recovery
Full stock executor, remote pairing/transfer and restore/fencing
Actual browser/platform providers, generated bindings, coherent consumers and final acceptance
implementation_scope: Fresh protected local buyer attachment/context and actual inquiry Prepared admission/query only; no installed message, issuance/delivery, complete receipt, seller stock, remote pairing or general recovery qualification.

command_data.canonicalization: Closed ASCII-key RFC 8785 subset with preserved Unicode, fixed numeric kind 30402, canonical decimal-string exact values and explicit required nulls; not a general-purpose JCS implementation
command_data.command_digest: SHA-256(radroots.command.v1 NUL || canonical command excluding context.correlation_id)
command_data.approval_intent_digest: SHA-256(radroots.approval.v1 NUL || canonical command excluding context.approval and context.correlation_id)
command_data.private_buffers: Zeroizing retained canonical command and decoded private text; borrowed raw private JSON during parsing

prepared_journal.single_participant_scope: One protected fresh local buyer grant per namespace; operations unique by complete workspace and operation ID
prepared_journal.admitted_effect: Protected authorized inquiry preparation only; no stock effect, installed chat, signature or publication
prepared_journal.retained_identity: Full operation and command digest plus original 32-byte transaction ID and positive revision
prepared_journal.replay: Current access and the original digest are verified before fresh planning, deadline or entropy; original correlation is retained
prepared_journal.unknown: Original operation/digest and observed nullable transaction identity are retained; uncertain owner blocks business admission/query until safe close/reopen and exact original-row reconciliation
prepared_journal.known_failure: No write was attempted, or actual rollback completed; commit/rollback uncertainty never becomes a known failure
prepared_journal.unavailable_history: Reply parents and order expectations are refused until authenticated history is implemented
prepared_journal.approval: Caller-provided approval descriptors are refused without a qualified protected consent origin
prepared_journal.predecessor_schema: Preserve and refuse the prior grant-only namespace; no implicit rewrite, deletion, re-enrollment or import
prepared_journal.transaction_recheck: The short transaction matches complete workspace/operation, participant/grant, command type/digest, original transaction, prepared phase/revision and exact retained protected bytes; matching ciphertext alone cannot hide changed indexed facts.
